items.title: Ulta Beauty (ULTA) Opens First Qatar Stores As Global Growth Moves Up A Gear
items.summary: Ulta Beauty (NasdaqGS:ULTA) has opened its first stores in Qatar, marking its initial physical expansion beyond the US market. The retailer is working with Kuwait based Alshaya Group to roll out a broader store network across the Middle East region. Management has signalled plans for additional locations in multiple Gulf markets following the Qatar launch.
